title: Two linked cells with distinct TABLECONTENT DATALINK targets

scope.operation: Write two linked-data cells in one rectangular TABLECONTENT grid with distinct DATALINK targets.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1032 table: upper-left linked cell with cached string/integer contents, lower-right empty linked cell, two distinct DATALINK records, and two scalar peer cells; ASCII and binary DXF.
limits: Exactly two linked cells and two unique DATALINK targets
Only the upper-left linked cell has cached content, with the selected string-then-integer sequence
No linked-cell block references, attributes, geometry, formatting, or real external workbook access
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer, graph preflight and typed readback evidence only; no native DATALINK/workbook behavior or DWG encoding claim.

implementation: Reuse adapter preflight's unique-target checks for two linked cells and two emitted DATALINK records.
Emit each linked cell's independent remapped target and group 93/94/96 metadata; preserve the content count/list on the first cell and the empty list on the second.
Do not access either inert connection string during export or validation.

physical_wire: Two DATALINK records are emitted at 0x1710 and 0x1711.
Linked flags by grid order are [1,0,0,1]; linked targets are [0x1710,0x1711] at the two linked cells.
The first cell emits 93=2, 94=3, 96=-5, 95=2 and the exact cached string/integer values; the second emits 93=4, 94=5, 96=7 and 95=0.
The two unlinked peer cells retain their scalar values and content count 1.
evidence.typed_readback: One TABLECONTENT at 0x15A0 reads two DATALINKs at 0x1710/0x1711; the upper-left and lower-right cells retain their respective target handles and exact metadata. The upper-left retains string then integer 42, and the other two cells retain their scalar strings.
evidence.failure_control: Each linked-cell target is independently changed to absent handle 0x799. Both exports are refused; the destination sentinel, failed source mutation, other linked-cell handle and table collection remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring each valid source handle lets the same adapter export again; both DATALINK records, cell references and cached values read back intact after each retry.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
This receipt does not qualify more than two linked cells, other content sequences or linked-cell payload types, broader DATALINK semantics, native TABLE/workbook behavior, or DWG output.
